csv_scope_of_work: The City of Leesburg is seeking proposals from qualified and experienced respondents to provide Design-Build Services pursuant to the Consultant s Competitive Negotiation Act (CCNA), for the turn-key design, permitting, and construction of eight (8) to twelve (12) lighted pickleball courts with permanent posts, and a well-planned connection between park features. The site of the project is on South Palmetto Street (see Attachment A Palmetto Pickleball Complex Site). The proposal also includes resurfacing four (4) tennis courts on the corner of South Palmetto Street and Woodward Street.
